story.title: Story 2: Manage Purpose, Access Mode, and Target Ref

result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 2 across the real metadata-update path and the user-visible source surfaces: shared contracts, Fastify PATCH route, source-management service policy, PlatformStore/Convex persistence, project-shell client update wiring, and project/process source rendering. I also checked the mapped TC evidence, supporting process-surface contract coverage, and audited the story-specific production path for fake adapters or shim-only behavior.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run convex/sourceAttachments.test.ts tests/service/server/source-management-api.test.ts tests/service/server/source-management-service.test.ts tests/service/server/process-work-surface-api.test.ts --environment node

corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/service/client/source-attachment-section.test.ts tests/service/client/process-materials-section.test.ts tests/service/client/project-router.test.ts --environment jsdom

additionalObservations: The story-specific runtime path is real code end to end: browser API PATCH helper -> Fastify route -> DefaultSourceManagementService -> PlatformStore -> Convex mutation. I did not find a fake adapter, placeholder branch, or shim replacing the production update behavior in that path.

Process-surface contract evidence is stronger than the chunk-2 client tests alone: tests/service/server/process-work-surface-api.test.ts shows currentSources carrying purpose, accessMode, targetRef, hydrationState, repositoryFullName, and attachmentScope through the API surface consumed by the process UI.

The story markdown still has a documentation-level response-contract ambiguity: its Update Response table describes a `{ "sourceAttachment": ... }` wrapper, while the shared contracts, route schema, browser API, definition-of-done text, and tests are internally consistent on returning a bare `SourceAttachmentSummary`. I did not treat that as blocking.
`verify-all` passed, but the repo-baseline `test:e2e` script is still a scaffold that prints a skip message by design.

AGENTS.md points to `docs/onboarding/current-state-*` files, but those onboarding files are not present in this checkout; verification proceeded from the story, tech design, test plan, code, and tests.
